trust_anchor: sha256(checkpoint file bytes) -- the loader hashes the checkpoint FILE and looks up this record by digest
trust_model_note: Trust is derived from the registry CONTENTS (operator-controlled), not from the checkpoint file path or from caller-controlled metadata such as meta.base. A checksum manifest detects corruption or mismatch only when checked against a trusted reference; it is NOT cryptographic protection against an attacker who can rewrite both the manifest and the artifact.
description: Trusted provenance for Genesis v0.6 legacy genesis-ckpt-v1 checkpoints. The loader hashes the checkpoint file, looks up by_checkpoint_sha256[sha], then cross-checks format/vocab/architecture/meta_base and requires co-located tokenizer.json whose canonical sha256 equals tokenizer_canonical_sha256. Modern format_version=1 checkpoints carry an embedded tokenizer and do not consult this registry.
